description: Get an overview of one Sentry trace by trace ID: trace statistics, a span breakdown, and a link to the trace in Sentry. Shows a condensed subset of spans, not every span; to list all spans in a trace, use search_traces.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

spanId.description: A span ID in the trace to focus on; omit for the trace overview.

name: get_trace_details
title: Get Trace Details
